title: Milwaukee Duffy Boat Rentals
specs: Scenic Milwaukee River loop with multiple bridge crossings
Renter must be 25+ with valid driver's license and credit card
If born after Jan 1, 1989, must complete online boating safety course
Boats fit up to 12 guests comfortably
Contact operator for groups larger than 12 to book multiple boats
includes: Cooler and ice on each boat
Bluetooth sound system on each boat
gap: Exact pricing tiers for different group sizes not fully detailed
blurb: Guests rent electric Duffy boats that are easy to drive, similar to a golf cart. Boats accommodate up to 12 people and cruise the Milwaukee River, passing under bridges and offering city views. Rentals typically last 2 hours, allowing time for a river loop and stops at bars.
extraNote: Cancel at least 3 days in advance · Light rain is acceptable; boats have roofs and zip-up windows · On bad weather days, renter can choose refund, rain check, or delay start time · Boone & Crockett Docks, 820 S Water St, Milwaukee, WI 53204 or Aloft Hotel Milwaukee, 1230 N Dr. Martin Luther King Jr Drive, Milwaukee, WI 53212
